€1Ā. (लभते, लेभे, अलब्ध, लप्स्यते, लब्धुम्, लब्ध) 
__1 To get, obtain, gain, acquire; लभेत सिकतासु तैलमपि यत्नतः पीडयन् [[

]]; चिराय याथार्थ्यमलम्भि दिग्गजैः [[Śi. 1. 64.]] 
__2 To have, possess, be in possession of. 
__3 To take, receive. 
__4 To catch, take or catch hold of; प्रांशुलभ्ये फले लोभादुद्बाहुरिब वामनः [[

.]] 
__5 To find, meet with; यत्किंचिल्लभते पथि. 
__6 To recover, regain. 
__7 To know, learn, perceive, understand; भ्रमणं … गमनादेव लभ्यते [[Bhāṣā

.]] [Page1358-2] 
__8 To be able or be permitted (to do a thing) (with inf.); मर्तुमपि न लभ्यते; नाधर्मो लभ्यते कर्तुं लोके वैद्याधरे. (The senses of लभ् are modified according to the noun with which it is used; i. e. गर्भ लभ् to conceive, become pregnant; पदं or आस्पदं लभ् to gain a footing, take a hold on; see under पद; अन्तरं लभ् to get a footing, enter into; लेभेऽन्तरं चेतसि नोपदेशः [[
]] ‘was not impressed on the mind;’ चेतनां-संज्ञां लभ् to regain one's consciousness; जन्म लभ् to be born; [[

]]; स्वास्थ्यं लभ् to enjoy ease, be at ease; दर्शनं लभ् to get an audience of &c.). -Caus. (लम्भयति-ते) 
__1 To cause to get or receive, cause to take; मधुरैरवशानि लम्भयन्नपि तिर्यञ्चि शमं निरीक्षितैः [[

.]] 
__2 To give, confer or bestow upon; मोदकशरावं माणवकं लम्भय [[

.]] 
__3 To cause to suffer. 
__4 To obtain, receive. 
__5 To find out, discover. -Desid. (लिप्सते) To wish to get, long for; अलब्धं चैव लिप्सेत [[

[लभ्-ल्युट्] 
__1 The act of getting, obtaining &c. 
__2 Act of conceiving.

__1 Wealth, riches. 
__2 One who solicits, a solicitor. 
-सम् A rope for tying a horse. (-m. also).

a. [लभ्-कर्मणि यत्] 
__1 Capable of being acquired or obtained, attainable, obtainable, to be reached; प्रांशुलभ्ये फले लोभादुद्बाहुरिव वामनः [[

.]] 
__3 Fit, suitable, proper. 
__4 Intelligible. 
__5 To be furnished or provided with; [[
a. = लाभार्ह; लभ्यो लाभ्यः स्याद्वलिभ्यः प्रशस्तः [[

[लभ्-भावे घञ्] 
__1 Gaining, obtaining, acquirement, acquisition; शरीरत्यागमात्रेण शुद्धिलाभममन्यत [[
]]; स्त्रीरत्नलाभम् 7. 34; 11. 92; क्षणमप्यवतिष्ठते श्वसन् यदि जन्तुर्ननु लाभवानसौ [[

.]] 
__2 Gain, profit, advantage; सुखदुःखे समे कृत्वा लाभालाभौ जयाजयौ [[

.]] 
__3 Enjoyment. 
__4 Capture, conquest. 
__5 Perception, knowledge, apprehension. 
__6 Treasure-trove; सप्त वित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः … … [[

.]] 
-Comp. 
-कर, -कृत् a. profitable, advantageous. 
-लिप्सा desire of gain, avarice, covetousness. 
-लिप्सु a. 
__1 greedy, covetous. 
__2 desirous of gain.
